#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
const ll MOD = 998244353;

ll pow_mod(ll a, ll b) {
    ll res = 1;
    while (b) {
        if (b & 1) res = (res * a) % MOD;
        a = (a * a) % MOD;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

ll even, odd;
unordered_map<ll, ll> dp0, dp1;

ll go(ll n, int x) {
    if (x == 0) {
        auto it = dp0.find(n);
        if (it != dp0.end()) return it->second;
        if (n == 1) {
            ll res = even;
            dp0[n] = res;
            return res;
        } else if (n == 2) {
            ll res = (even * even + odd * odd) % MOD;
            dp0[n] = res;
            return res;
        }
        ll a1 = go(n / 2, 0);
        ll a2 = go(n - n / 2, 0);
        ll b1 = go(n / 2, 1);
        ll b2 = go(n - n / 2, 1);
        ll res = (a1 * a2 + b1 * b2) % MOD;
        dp0[n] = res;
        return res;
    } else {
        auto it = dp1.find(n);
        if (it != dp1.end()) return it->second;
        if (n == 1) {
            ll res = odd;
            dp1[n] = res;
            return res;
        } else if (n == 2) {
            ll res = (even * odd + odd * even) % MOD;
            dp1[n] = res;
            return res;
        }
        ll a1 = go(n / 2, 0);
        ll a2 = go(n - n / 2, 1);
        ll b1 = go(n / 2, 1);
        ll b2 = go(n - n / 2, 0);
        ll res = (a1 * a2 + b1 * b2) % MOD;
        dp1[n] = res;
        return res;
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    ll n, m, l, r;
    cin >> n >> m >> l >> r;
    ll sz = n * m;

    if (sz % 2 == 0) {
        even = (r - l + 1) / 2;
        if ((r - l) % 2 == 0 && l % 2 == 0) even++;
        odd = r - l + 1 - even;
        dp0.clear();
        dp1.clear();
        cout << go(sz, 0) << '\n';
    } else {
        ll ans = pow_mod(r - l + 1, sz);
        cout << ans << '\n';
    }

    return 0;
}
